name: Couillon
summary: Belgian partnership trick-taking game with forced follow-or-trump rules and a ladder scoring with penalty loops.
rules_text: 24 cards: A-K-Q-J-10-9 per suit, Ace high. Values: A=4, K=3, Q=2, J=1, total 40. Four players in fixed partnerships opposite each other. Dealer shuffles, deals 2 at a time to each until 4 each, 8 cards remain. Top undealt card is proposed trumps. In order left of dealer, each player may accept it for his team. If all pass, bottom undealt card's suit is trump. Eldest leads to trick one. Must follow led suit or play a trump if you hold the led suit. You may trump even if able to follow. If void in led suit, any card. Illegal only to discard off-suit non-trump while able to follow. Highest trump wins, else highest of led suit. Winner leads next. After four tricks, count card points. Higher score wins a game point. If team that accepted trumps loses on card points, they get a boucle on their ladder - needs two future wins to erase. First team to erase all rungs wins.
